title: •Careful Planning
caption: •Careful Planning (V)
game_text: STARTING: If your starting location was a battleground site, ▼ up to two related locations (one must be a system) with < 4 total {light-force} and up to three Effects that are always {alter}. Place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.
lore: Alliance troops on planet must plan ahead to achieve success in military operations.

notes: ERRATA: the sheet cover reads '(Errata to card #5 and #30 on June 25, 2007)' — this transcription is what this Remaster sheet prints (the stub's game_text_note calls it post-errata); the pre-errata wording is not on this sheet. The slip's bottom strip prints a small gold/bronze sphere between the caption and the number — the errata marker (it appears only on the errata'd #5, #22, #30), not transcribed as an icon. Unique (•). Banner STARTING INTERRUPT (printed base is a Used Or Starting Interrupt). Inline black square with a white/cyan diagonal after '< 4 total' → {light-force} (Light Side Force icons; matches assets/icons/inline-force-light.png) — the stub dropped it ('with < 4 total and'). ▼ where the stub expands the phrase; red circle-slash A → {alter} (stub 'Immune to Alter'). Margin credits: left 'Original concept by Kevin Brownell', right 'Illinois States 2004'. Lore matches the scan and the 745 px V0 remake. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright line read off the V0 remake: Endor form, 1999. Modern: V0-L-carefulplanning.gif (745 px); VB4 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
